questions.learningObjective: Identify the main idea of a short French passage

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The chart mainly shows a steady rise in coffee drinking in both cities over time.
The chart mainly shows that Marseille consistently drinks more coffee than Lyon.
options.misconception: confuses a side detail with the overall trend

options.text: The chart mainly shows that coffee prices fell sharply during the period.
options.misconception: imports a claim about price that the graph never makes

options.text: The chart mainly shows that Lyon stopped drinking coffee after 2020.
options.misconception: overreads a single low bar as a total disappearance

questions.explanation: The bars rise in both cities, so the main idea is a shared upward trend. The key is A, "The chart mainly shows a steady rise in coffee drinking in both cities over time". Option B ("The chart mainly shows that Marseille consistently drinks more coffee than Lyon") is wrong: confuses a side detail with the overall trend. Option C ("The chart mainly shows that coffee prices fell sharply during the period") is wrong: imports a claim about price that the graph never makes. Option D ("The chart mainly shows that Lyon stopped drinking coffee after 2020") is wrong: overreads a single low bar as a total disappearance.
questions.hint: Look at the direction of both sets of bars.
